results.name: Barbell Jump Shrug
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, bend at your hips and knees to grip the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Hold the barbell against your thighs.
Begin the exercise by hinging at the hips, lowering the barbell to knee level, then explosively extend your hips and knees and lightly jump off the floor, while shrugging your shoulders.
Allow the barbell to rise naturally from the momentum without pulling it with your arms.
Land softly with your knees slightly bent, absorb the impact, and reset before performing the next repetition.
tips: Keep your arms straight throughout the entire movement.
Generate power from your hips and legs rather than your shoulders.
Maintain a neutral spine, keep your chest up and brace your core before each repetition.
Exhale during the explosive jump and inhale as you reset.
results.description: Barbell Jump Shrug is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the traps (back). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the plyometric category. Secondary muscles: Forearms, Core.

results.name: Battle Rope Alternating Arm Waves
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and hold the ends of the battle ropes with a neutral grip. Lean your torso forward, bend your knees slightly and brace your core.
Raise one arm while lowering the other to create alternating waves in the ropes.
Continue alternating your arms in a smooth, controlled rhythm while keeping your torso stable.
Maintain the movement for the desired duration, then lower the ropes with control.
tips: Generate the waves with your arms while maintaining a stable body position.
Keep your shoulders down and avoid shrugging during each repetition.
Avoid rounding your back by keeping your chest up throughout the exercise.
Maintain an even rhythm to produce consistent alternating waves.
results.description: Battle Rope Alternating Arm Waves is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the cardiovascular system (cardio). Performed with a rope, it falls under the cardio category. Secondary muscles: Biceps, Triceps, Forearms.

results.name: Battle Rope Double Arm Slams
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and hold the ends of the battle ropes with a neutral grip. Bend your knees slightly and engage your core.
Raise both arms together to bring the ropes upward, moving through the shoulder joint, while keeping your torso stable.
Forcefully slam both ropes toward the floor by driving your arms downward and slightly hinging at your hips.
Continue repeating the movement with control for the desired duration.
tips: Generate power by driving your arms down forcefully during each slam.
Allow a slight hip hinge to help produce powerful slams.
Keep a consistent rhythm while maintaining good technique.
Inhale as you raise the ropes and exhale as you slam them to the floor.
results.description: Battle Rope Double Arm Slams is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the cardiovascular system (cardio). Performed with a rope, it falls under the cardio category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Triceps, Biceps.

results.name: Bear Crawls
instructions: Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders, your knees under your hips, and your knees slightly off the floor.
Move one hand and the opposite foot forward at the same time while keeping your hips level.
Continue crawling forward with alternating hand and foot movements while maintaining a steady pace, until you complete the desired distance or duration.
tips: Keep your knees just above the floor throughout the exercise.
Keep your hips level and minimize side-to-side movement.
Keep your movements slow and controlled rather than rushing forward.
Maintain a neutral spine and avoid arching or rounding your back.
results.description: Bear Crawls is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Chest, Triceps, Glutes.

results.name: Box Sled Push
instructions: Load the sled and grip the handles or upright posts with your arms extended.
Lean forward at about 45 degrees with your body in a straight line.
Drive the sled forward with short, powerful steps, pushing through the balls of your feet.
Keep pushing for the set distance or time.
tips: Keep your back flat and your core braced.
Short steps keep the sled moving smoothly.
results.description: Box Sled Push is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a sled machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Calves, Hamstrings, Shoulders.

results.name: Burpee To Pull-Up
instructions: Stand under a pull-up bar.
Squat down, place your hands on the floor and jump your feet back into a plank, then jump them back in.
Jump up to grab the bar and pull your chin over it.
Lower yourself, drop down and go straight into the next burpee.
tips: Land softly from the jump before the pull-up.
Use a band on the bar if the pull-up is too hard.
results.description: Burpee To Pull-Up is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the cardiovascular system (cardio). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the cardio category. Secondary muscles: Chest, Quadriceps, Biceps.

results.name: Burpees
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down and place your hands on the floor in front of your feet.
Jump your feet back into a plank, then jump them back in toward your hands.
Explode up into a jump, reaching your arms overhead, and land softly into the next rep.
tips: Keep your core tight in the plank so your hips don't sag.
Step back instead of jumping to make it easier.
results.description: Burpees is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the cardiovascular system (cardio). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the cardio category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Chest, Shoulders.

results.name: Butt Kick (Slow)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms relaxed by your sides.
Begin by jogging in place, lifting your heels towards your buttocks with each step.

Alternate lifting your right and left heels in a quick, continuous motion, keeping your knees pointing down. Swing your arms naturally with each step, allowing them to move opposite to your legs for balance.
Maintain a steady pace for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your upper body upright and avoid leaning forward to maintain proper form.
Engage your core to support balance and stability throughout the exercise.
Focus on a quick, light motion with each heel lift to effectively engage your hamstrings.
results.description: Butt Kick (Slow) is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the cardiovascular system (cardio). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the cardio category. Secondary muscles: Calves, Glutes.

results.name: Crawl With Sled Drag
instructions: Attach a light sled to a harness or belt around your waist.
Get on your hands and feet in a bear-crawl position with your knees just off the floor.
Crawl forward, moving opposite hand and foot together, dragging the sled behind you.
Continue for the set distance with your back flat.
tips: Keep your hips level and low.
Take small, controlled steps.
results.description: Crawl With Sled Drag is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a sled machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Glutes, Triceps.
